title: A link whose label slot the plan hides is hidden with it before the plan check, so R10b sends no fix round for it
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: On the JA Boxing kit, a kept contact block that hides the map button's label and leaves the button undecided fails R10b before the planner step reads it; after, the button is in hiddenSlots with the reason, R10b passes and R24 reports nothing; a menu item label printed by the header and the mobile menu takes the header link with it.

A label the decision also writes, a label two kit blocks print (block-176.1) and a link the plan decided are left alone; a visible undecided link in a kept row and ambiguous row ownership still fail R10b.

tests: a link whose label slot the decision hides is hidden with it
a written label, a label other blocks print and a link the plan decided stay with the planner
a menu item label printed by the header and the mobile menu still takes the header link with it
a visible undecided child link remains a checker failure
ambiguous row ownership and contradictory parent decisions stay unresolved
